quote: By completing the statistical analysis of their results, one finds that the phenomenon claimed by Ganz can very well be replicated.
notes: A reply/commentary by the original author defending Ganz (2014) against Bailey et al. (2016)'s reproduction; it completes the statistical analysis of Bailey et al.'s reported results rather than conducting a new replication. If treated as a replication-type record, the finding at stake is @ganz2014 and the analysed study is @bailey2016.
